description: T-1933 (from T-1853): a legacy (plain <f>) cell stays legacy after a row is inserted above it. Before the insert A5 = 1, A6 = 10; B2 =N(IF(1,{2;3}))+A5 and C2 =N(IF(1,A5:A6))+A5 are legacy, D2 is B2's dynamic twin, E2 =FORMULATEXT(B2). The insert_row op puts a blank row above row 1, so every cell is scored one row down (B3, C3, D3:D4, E3). SPEC-0012 rule 6. Only the moved formula cells are scored (`check`): the inputs are written at their pre-insert addresses.
